title: OtaManifest
description: Server to kiosk update offer. Firmware and models roll independently: the models partition is A/B on its own, so a model update never reflashes the app.

url.description: HTTPS only. The kiosk validates the server certificate against the CA bundled in firmware.

sha256.description: Digest of the whole image, verified after download and before the slot is marked active.

sizeBytes.description: Checked against free partition space before the download starts.

signature.description: Detached signature over sha256. Required in production builds, where Secure Boot v2 is on.

minFwVersion.description: MODELS only: refuse the image if the running firmware is older, so a new model never meets an interpreter that cannot run its ops.

runId.description: MODELS only: the ml/ run directory this image came from, copied from contracts/models.lock.json.

forced.description: Install without waiting for the idle window.
